properties.title: MISSION 1 - STANDING WATCH
properties.objective: Clear the Choir picket from the transit lane.
briefingLines:
Fuel convoy Skimmer Ferrous and Skimmer Anneal are yours to see through.
They are slow, they are unarmed, and the Reach does not have others.

LEFT CLICK any vessel to bring up its readout.
Start with the Ardent Dominion - the big one. She is the flagship.

RIGHT CLICK empty space to order the selected vessel there.
RIGHT CLICK a hostile to engage it instead.

MIDDLE DRAG orbits the camera. WASD pans. The WHEEL zooms.
SPACE frames everything still flying.

Long-range returns: three Choir platforms holding the transit lane.
They have not moved in eleven years. They are about to.

Get your screen out ahead of the tankers before they close.
The Dominion cannot be replaced. Do not lose her.
